source: Gemini 3.8 Flash (agy), targeted listening on short clips of the official video audio, captions excluded; 2026-10-21. Same model as recheck-gemini.json: one witness, not two.

places.question: In the Turkish lines, is the word «şeydâ» or «şeytan»? Give both occurrences with times.
places.answer: The word is «şeydâ» in both occurrences (not «şeytan»): first at 59.2–60.7 s in line fuzuli-f3-1 («dil-i şeydâ içün»), and second at 70.9–72.5 s in line fuzuli-f4-1 («kâm-ı dil-i şeydâ nedir»).

segments.heard: gerçi cânândan dil-i şeydâ içün kâm isterem
sorsa cânân bilmezem kâm-ı dil-i şeydâ nedir

places.question: After «Karitas habundat in omnia», is there a separate choral «in omnia» repeat?
places.answer: Yes, there is a separate choral «in omnia» repeat immediately following the soloist.

places.question: Is the line «ah u feryâdın fuzûlî incidipdir âlemi» sung here? When?
places.answer: Yes, the line is clearly sung by Sami Yusuf between 254.6 s and 260.8 s (clip time 00:03.6–00:09.8).

segments.heard: ah u feryâdın fuzûlî incidipdir âlemi

places.question: Is «ياهو» (ya hu) called out here? When?
places.answer: Yes, «ياهو» is called out from 291.3 to 298.3 s.

places.question: How many times is «الكل لما سقيت تاهوا» sung, and when?
places.answer: «الكل لما سقيت تاهوا» is sung 2 times: first from 486.3 s to 494.4 s, and second from 495.0 s to 504.1 s.

places.question: How many times is «صبرت قلبي» sung, where does each pass end?
places.answer: «صَبَّرْتُ قَلْبِي» is sung 2 times: the first pass ends at 532.4 s (530.2–532.4 s, «صَبَّرْتُ قَلْبِي» alone); the second pass of «صَبَّرْتُ قَلْبِي» ends at 535.2 s (533.4–535.2 s), continuing seamlessly in the same breath with «عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَجَابَنِي» to complete line sabr-p1 at 538.8 s (533.4–538.8 s). The preceding line nabulsi-n2 singing finishes at 529.4 s, and sabr-p2 begins at 539.4 s.

places.question: Is a fragment of «öyle ser-mestem ki idrâk etmezem» sung here? Exactly which words?
places.answer: No, no fragment of «öyle ser-mestem ki idrâk etmezem» is sung here.

segments.heard: sorsa cânân bilmezem kâm-ı dil-i şeydâ nedir

places.question: Is another pass of the antiphon «Karitas habundat in omnia» sung here? Which lines?
places.answer: Yes, another pass of the antiphon «Karitas habundat in omnia» is sung here. Lines H1 through H5 are sung: «Karitas habundat in omnia», «de imis excellentissima», «super sidera», «atque amantissima», and «in omnia». The final line H6 («quia summo regi osculum pacis dedit») is not sung.
